svg.title: How one row stays in sync

cc:Work.dc:title: How one row stays in sync
cc:Work.dc:description: Five illustrative PostgreSQL row states: in sync, edited, copied and acknowledged, soft-deleted pending synchronization, and deletion copied and acknowledged. needs_sync and is_deleted values are color-coded.
